hardware_summary: Three 15 MW natural gas-fired turbine generators (45 MW aggregate), as designed, dedicated to powering the terminal's own site facilities — not for external electricity sale.
source_notes: AES Ocean LNG's cancelled Ocean Cay import terminal (Bimini, proposed ~2002, EIA approved 2003, abandoned by 2009) was designed with three 15 MW natural gas-fired turbine generators on-site 'to generate power for the facilities of the project' — i.e., house power for the terminal's own regas/pumping/compression systems, not electricity for external sale. The project never proceeded past the design/EIA stage before the Bahamian government let it lapse amid local opposition.
